column3: A market intermediary or registered person shall
trade in or otherwise deal in securities outside the
exchange of which he is a trading participant without
the prior approval of the Commission;
trade in securities in contravention of such rules of
the Commission or the rules of a market institution;
effect any transaction in a margin account in a manner
contrary to the requirements set out by the market
institution of which he is a trading participant; or
effect any transaction by means of any manipulative,
deceptive or other fraudulent device or contrivance
in order to induce or attempt to induce the purchase
